name: pr-address-comments
summary: 用于梳理 Gemini CLI 当前分支上的 GitHub 拉取请求反馈。技能文档以 `scripts/fetch-pr-info.js` 为入口，需要 GitHub CLI（`gh`）。它结合改动差异、提交记录和评论，简述已解决的讨论，并给待处理的讨论编号。由你选定要处理的评论后，才开始修改。

For the GitHub pull request on the current Gemini CLI branch, the skill’s guide starts with `scripts/fetch-pr-info.js` and requires the GitHub CLI (`gh`). It uses the diff, commit history, and comments to summarize resolved threads and number open ones. You choose which comments to address before any fixes begin.
